requirements.title: Certification matrix registry
requirements.description: Every mandatory qualification case has a stable ID, owner, fixture, assertion and receipt reference; a required cell without compatible evidence refuses certification.

validation.notes: Embedded matrix is byte-identical to certification/matrix.json; 94 cases with stable IDs, lanes, dimensions, requirement refs and owners; unsupported cells declared.

Empty evidence names all 94 cases; a failed receipt is listed under failed and never masked; evidence for another release digest is stale; unavailable verdicts never pass; readiness only when every lane holds a passed receipt for the exact digest.
Fixture catalog loads; oracle checksum reproducible from seed (P02-A06); every fixture declares lease scope and owned-ephemeral target ownership (P02-A02/A03 groundwork); no product names.
Fault registry cannot be armed outside routed test mode and Hit never fires in production contexts (P02-O04).

requirements.title: QEMU fresh-host qualification
requirements.description: The minimal fixture lifecycle, reboot, interruption and restore cases pass on pristine Ubuntu 24.04 images for each declared architecture, with source images unchanged after teardown.

validation.notes: Absent host tools produce a typed unavailable readiness naming vrooli setup and the hostTools owner; arm64 on an amd64 host is tcg, never kvm; a mutated source image is a digest mismatch (P20-A05 groundwork, P20-A06).
GET /api/v1/instances/readiness answers 200 with state unavailable and the vrooli setup next action.

certification/lanes/qemu.json holds exactly the matrix cases with lane qemu; the program's admission set equals the lane; every qemu cell carries an explicit unavailable receipt naming EXT-05/EXT-06 and readiness stays not_ready.

Governed qualification program: 8 fixtures refuse absent authorization, incompatible target (including any deployment not bound to the owned guest), stale artifact, unknown fault and non-zero spend before mutation; act phase deploys through deployment/apply (destructive, confirmed) + operation/wait and observes health; a real run needs the host tools and an owned guest (EXT-05, EXT-06).

requirements.title: Authorized real-VPS qualification
requirements.description: Installation, update, public DNS/TLS, management-loss reattachment, replacement-host restore and publication identity are proven on an authorized disposable VPS; missing authority keeps the cell explicitly pending.

validation.notes: Authorized disposable VPS authority is not present in this environment. Keep installation, update, DNS/TLS, reattachment, replacement-host restore and publication evidence pending until an authorized target and receipts exist.

requirements.title: Adversarial validation, soak and generality
requirements.description: Threat-model rows, credential-canary scans, independent review, 24-hour soak budgets and a declaration-only fixture scenario are evidenced; no product-name branch exists in generic cloud code.

validation.notes: Frozen phase-23 budgets load and validate (every fixture profile, retry class, queue/retention/soak/detection bound; drift from phase-1 numbers refused); small samples flagged and never judged; exceeded verdict names phase and metric; harness against an httptest handler yields a complete four-phase measurement with process snapshots; url target requires an explicit --target (P23-O01, P23-O02).

Every execplan retry class has a finite ceiling and capped backoff; operations.DefaultConfig timeouts bounded and equal to the frozen budget; RUN-08 serialisation referenced not duplicated; backup.Plan and bundle.PlanVPSBundleGC never delete protected/active artifacts under the frozen or an aggressive policy (P23-A06); a stale observation cannot report healthy; alert conditions and resolved transitions (P23-A03 package lane, P23-A04/A05 contract).

12 update cycles through operations.Service leave no non-terminal operation, lease or active step and no goroutine/fd/RSS growth beyond post_cleanup_growth; recovery-point set bounded by keep_last + protected (OPS-04 package lane).

Soak, real-VPS and QEMU lanes for OPS-01..03 and OPS-05..08 are unavailable pending EXT-09/EXT-01/EXT-06; threat-model rows, canary scans, independent review and the declaration-only fixture are owned by phases 22/24.

P24-A01..A05 package lane over the declaration-only fixture newcomer-service and a fake cloud-target owner: closure with reasons, needs_input handoff, durable admission, argv --deployment --operation --step --fence discipline, receipts bound to operation+fence, secret canary absent, health observation bound to deployment+release, two environments isolated (ids, target keys, credential binding ids, edge specs, no cross-calls), linux/arm64 refusal naming ledger-store:missing_platform_artifact, update keeps the declared route and private callback listener, stateless-web plan digest equals the golden, no cloud source names the fixture. Three route assertions are red until execplan/vps derive edge.route.apply from edge.Derive (requested from the consolidation owner, 2026-09-09).
newcomer-service fixture loads with a verified seed/oracle and carries no product name or secret.
Package-lane OPS-08 receipt is written by api/generality (STC_WRITE_OPS08=1) once every assertion passes; real-VPS soak and QEMU lanes remain pending EXT-01/EXT-06/EXT-09.

Ownership boundaries over the parsed module source (go/ast): only reach/sshadapter may import the ssh package (DL-02); os/exec confined to declared local-process owners with a stale-entry check; no product-name literal outside the documented manifest-doctor example (P24-O05); every persistence method that writes cloud_operations (derived from the SQL) is called only from api/operations (DL-05; admission moved to operations.Admit); cloud-target credential verbs composed only in api/credentials and the credential-authority library opened only by declared owners (DL-14).

Every literal route registration in main.go and handlers_*.go has an authz.Table row (source-level census beside the live census, STC-P0-013); every effectful row is TargetBound or carries an allowlist reason; stale allowlist entries fail.

Every workload fixture compiles to a full-scope plan against a complete release set; every action input and every derived target argv (vps.ActionCommands) passes reach.ValidateArgs, so no shell syntax enters the target boundary (P25-A01).

Every fenced scenario-to-cloud and vrooli cloud-target invocation under docs/ names a command declared by the owning cli/manifest.json; a failure prints file:line and the nearest command (P25-A02, P25-A04).
